resources.string:
Options Menu Demo

Demonstrates:
• Options Menu with three actions
• Toast feedback for user actions
• Screen navigation with Back handling
• Fault diagnosis and correction

ICS 2300 - Lab 3 Homework 3
No records stored yet.\nUse "Add Record" from the menu.

This demonstrates a deliberate fault:

An incorrect item ID was used in the menu handler.

Symptom: Selecting "Add Record" showed "View Records" toast.
Cause: Case statement used wrong ID constant.
Fix: Corrected to use R.id.menu_add_record.

This confirms why stable IDs matter over labels.

This app demonstrates an Options Menu with three actions:

1. Add Record – Shows Toast feedback and adds a record to the internal list.
2. View Records – Navigates to a second screen (RecordsActivity) showing all stored records. Press Back to return without duplicate actions.
3. About – Shows an AlertDialog with app information.

Menu Access: Tap the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner of the action bar.

Fault Demo: Use the button below to toggle a deliberate fault (incorrect item ID) and observe the symptom, then toggle off to see the correction.
Fault Demo: ON (Incorrect ID in use)
Menu Resource: res/menu/options_menu.xml\nItems: Add Record (R.id.menu_add_record), View Records (R.id.menu_view_records), About (R.id.menu_about)
